summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 12. Verified bilingual translation of PATIENT_PROFILES cards + modal (ES/EN), Testimonials text translation, removal of 15% discount panel in /empresas, differentiation of previously-repeated handshake icons, structural integrity of /empresas, and backend health. All requested feedback items are implemented correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: translations.js still contains unused `porque.benefitEyebrow/benefitTitle/benefitText` and a legacy `benefits` array (both ES and EN) with a '15% descuento' string. They are not rendered by Empresas.jsx anymore, but consider deleting the dead keys to avoid future accidental re-rendering.
ProfileExplorer L() helper uses `v[lang] || v.es` which is fine; ensure any future author-provided profile objects always include both `es` and `en` to avoid silent fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language toggle persists in localStorage under key `horvath_lang` (NOT `lang`). Test verified: (1) /pacientes cards show 'Elite male wellness', 'Premium women's health', 'Express health check' in EN and Spanish equivalents in ES; (2) /pacientes modal in EN shows English title, summary, group labels ('HEMATOLOGIC & METABOLIC PANEL', 'TUMOR MARKERS', 'HORMONAL & PROSTATE PANEL' - uppercased via CSS) and 'Recommended for:' label; individual study names remain in Spanish as expected. Modal closes via Escape and overlay click (both verified). (3) Home testimonials switch text between ES ('Buenísima la atención...') and EN ('The attention I received was excellent...') while names/source badges preserved. (4) /empresas porque-aliarse: no .benefit-highlight, no '15%' text, no 'Beneficio para tu equipo' / 'A perk for your team', exactly 4 reason cards. (5) Icons differentiated: hero handshake vs porque first-card user icon vs cta-band sparkle - all three SVGs verified distinct. (6) /empresas structural: hero 2 buttons, services-empresas 4 cards, como-flow 4 steps, empresas-menu-btn present, cta-band 2 buttons. (7) Backend GET /api/health returns 200 {status: healthy}. Restored lang to ES at end of tests.
rca of the issue: N/A - all previously-flagged items implemented correctly. Minor housekeeping note: dead i18n keys (benefitEyebrow/benefitText/benefits array) remain in translations.js but are not referenced by any component; safe to remove.
